content.short: Renzo is a Liquid Restaking Token protocol and EigenLayer Strategy Manager, simplifying restaking for ETH holders with the ezETH token.
content.description: Renzo Protocol is a liquid restaking token (LRT) protocol abstracting the complexity of EigenLayer restaking for everyday users. Users deposit ETH or liquid staking tokens into Renzo and receive ezETH  a liquid restaking token earning both staking and AVS rewards simultaneously. Renzo's strategy manager automatically optimizes allocation across EigenLayer's AVS ecosystem for risk-adjusted yield maximization. Deployed on Mantle, Renzo makes liquid restaking benefits accessible to Mantle DeFi users.
content.meta: Renzo is a liquid restaking token protocol built on EigenLayer, accessible through Mantle. Discover Renzo on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
